tagline.en_US: Manage UniFi access points, switches and gateways from your own network controller.

description.en_US: UniFi Network Application is Ubiquiti's controller software for UniFi access points, switches and gateways, packaged by LinuxServer.io. It adopts devices, pushes their configuration and shows clients, traffic and alerts in a web dashboard. The application keeps its data in a separate MongoDB database, and devices keep working on their own when the controller is offline.
